The '''Southern Reach''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The planet's [[Oasis South|southern oasis]] was located near this region.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', the Southern Reach was one of many designated planetary regions,<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
